Thanks again for interviewing with us — really enjoyed our conversation on scaling routing for multi-model inference. Attached is the take-home challenge we discussed (inference-challenge-v2.pdf). A couple of quick notes:

- Deliverables: single PDF write-up (design + tradeoffs) and a short runnable notebook (starter-dataset.zip contains a tiny toy dataset and minimal harness).
- Submission: reply to this thread with attachments or upload to the Drive link below and paste the link in your reply.
